interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with appropriate signage to provide safe crossing points for residents.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or speed cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential environment.

interventions.title: Dedicated Bicycle Infrastructure
interventions.description: Replace sharrows with dedicated or protected bike lanes to separate cyclists from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections or appropriate mid-block locations to improve pedestrian visibility and right-of-way.

interventions.title: Traffic calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune or thin out dense vegetation near the roadway to maintain clear sight triangles for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours, as none are currently visible.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to physically reduce vehicle speeds in this residential zone.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalks at key locations to provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Ensure adequate pedestrian-scale lighting is installed to improve safety and visibility during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a pedestrian refuge island, to provide a safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near driveways and intersections to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures like speed humps to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and improve the overall safety and predictability of vehicle movements.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Maintain and enhance the tree canopy to provide a psychological narrowing effect on the road and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority and encourage drivers to slow down.

interventions.title: Chicanes

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security after dark.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety during nighttime hours.
